log.text: Gholdengo used Make It Rain → Kingambit
Gholdengo used Make It Rain → Farigiraf

decisions.rationale: Same winning core: Ttar+Exca lead with Smooth Rock sand — Ttar is the Sucker-Punch-proof Kingambit answer (Low Kick 4x) and Sand Rush Exca outspeeds Mega Gardevoir, OHKOing it with Iron Head. Back Gholdengo as the Gardevoir/Farigiraf pivot (immune to Aura Sphere, Hyper Voice, and their Make It Rain-style chip) plus Sinistcha for Rage Powder redirection, Heatproof vs H-Arcanine/Mystical Fire, and its own Trick Room to contest Farigiraf's.
decisions.notebook:
Verified dmg (L50, sand, Champions): Exca LO Iron Head vs Mega Gardevoir 118-234% (OHKO); Exca LO High Horsepower vs Kingambit 80.7-139.4%; Ttar Low Kick vs Kingambit =120BP 4x, 98.6-169%; Kingambit BlackGlasses Sucker Punch vs Ttar only 17.7-25.1% (Ttar = Sucker-Punch-proof answer), vs Exca 59.4-83.9%; Modest Mega Gardevoir Aura Sphere vs Ttar 83.4-118.9% (never leave Ttar exposed to live Gardevoir), Mystical Fire vs Exca 49.3-83.2%, vs Gholdengo 38.1-100%. Sand Rush Exca 236 outspeeds all but Tailwind Noivern.
Opp G1 four: Farigiraf+Gardevoir lead, Kingambit+Noivern back; H-Arcanine/Milotic reserve (expect one in G2/G3). Farigiraf clicks Trick Room T1 (Colbur, Armor Tail blocks priority); Noivern is the Tailwind swing; Gardevoir held un-Mega'd until it enters.
Tendencies: very heavy Protect (Gardevoir T1, Farigiraf T2, Kingambit T3) — punish the turn after a Protect, never double into a fresh Protect slot. They click Sucker Punch into Protect (auto-fail), so Protect blanks Kingambit.
Principles: Kingambit walls Exca (no status) — Protect/switch or kill via Ttar Low Kick / Exca High Horsepower. Gholdengo immune to Aura Sphere/Hyper Voice = ideal Gardevoir pivot, useless vs Kingambit. Their Trick Room helps our Adamant Ttar; don't panic-remove, just avoid needing Exca speed those 5 turns. Sinistcha Rage Powder shields Ttar from Aura Sphere and Exca from Sucker Punch.
Game plan each game: lead Ttar+Exca, back Gholdengo+Sinistcha.

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf+Arcanine lead: Intimidate weakens both sand sweepers, Armor Tail blocks any stray priority, and Farigiraf sets Trick Room safely. Kingambit+Gardevoir back: both abuse Trick Room — Kingambit with Dark STAB for Gholdengo/Sinistcha, Gardevoir-Mega Pixilate Hyper Voice shreds Tyranitar (4×). Arcanine's Extreme Speed and Rock/Fire coverage round out the plan.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Opponent led Tyranitar (Smooth Rock, Sand Stream, Crunch, Rock Slide, Low Kick, Protect) + Excadrill (Life Orb, Sand Rush, High Horsepower, Iron Head, Rock Slide, Protect). They used double Protect effectively. Farigiraf's Colbur Berry consumed early. Opponent backline: Gholdengo (WiseGlasses), Rotom-Heat (Sitrus), Sinistcha (Leftovers, Heatproof), Floette-Eternal (Floettite, Flower Veil→Mega: Fairy Aura). Floette-Mega Fairy Aura boosts all Fairy moves 1.33x, including my Gardevoir-Mega. Sinistcha has Trick Room to reverse mine. Tyranitar's Low Kick threatens Kingambit. Excadrill outspeeds everything in sand.

decisions.rationale: Sand Rush Excadrill (236) moves first and LO High Horsepower is a guaranteed 4x OHKO on Arcanine-Hisui (146-268%), removing their fast attacker before Trick Room lands (TR is -7, so this turn is normal order; under TR Excadrill would be last). Tyranitar can't out-damage that, so it chips the TR setter: Crunch (38.8-71.8%, ~19-36% after Colbur) burns Farigiraf's Colbur Berry so later Crunches hit full, and beats Low Kick (neutral 1x here) in output.
decisions.notebook:
SIM CHART QUIRK: Fighting is resisted by Psychic here -> Ttar Low Kick vs Farigiraf only NEUTRAL (100BP, no STAB); Crunch is the better Farigiraf tool. Low Kick vs Kingambit still 4x/120BP (98.6-169%). Rock is NOT resisted by Rock here (Rock Slide 2x on H-Arcanine).
Verified dmg (L50, sand, Champions, -1 Atk where noted): Exca LO High Horsepower vs H-Arcanine 146-268% = guaranteed OHKO even at -1; Ttar -1 Crunch vs Farigiraf 38.8-71.8% (halve on first hit: Colbur); Ttar -1 Rock Slide vs H-Arcanine 30.7-56.5%, vs Farigiraf 13.2-25.1%. Exca LO Iron Head OHKOs Mega Gardevoir. Exca LO HH vs Kingambit 80.7-139%. Kingambit Sucker Punch vs Ttar only 17.7-25.1% (Ttar = Sucker-proof), vs Exca 59.4-83.9%. Mega Gardevoir Aura Sphere vs Ttar 83.4-118.9% (never leave Ttar vs live Gardevoir); Mystical Fire vs Exca 49.3-83.2%.
Opp G2 lead: Farigiraf + H-Arcanine (Intimidate on entry: our leads start -1 Atk). Back likely Kingambit/Noivern/Gardevoir/Milotic. Farigiraf: Armor Tail blocks priority, TR turn 1-2. Noivern = Tailwind swing (only thing outspeeding Sand Rush Exca). Team is Protect-heavy: punish the turn after a Protect; Kingambit's Sucker Punch auto-fails into Protect.
Plan: lead Ttar+Exca, back Gholdengo (immune to Aura Sphere/Hyper Voice) + Sinistcha (Rage Powder shields Ttar from Aura Sphere, Exca from Sucker Punch). Their TR aids Adamant Ttar; don't panic, just avoid needing Exca speed those turns.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Arcanine-Hisui)
decisions.rationale: Trick Room is essential to neutralize Sand Rush Excadrill. Arcanine Protects to survive the guaranteed OHKO from Excadrill's High Horsepower. Farigiraf may be doubled, but at -1 Atk, Crunch+IronHead ranges 79–112% — it survives unless both roll high. If opponents double Protect, Trick Room goes up freely. Under TR, Kingambit and Gardevoir-Mega dominate.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Opponent same lead as G1. Farigiraf's Colbur Berry intact this game. Trick Room is our win condition. Sinistcha has Trick Room to reverse ours — must track when it enters. Floette-Mega's Fairy Aura also boosts our Gardevoir-Mega. Kingambit remains our TR sweeper; Low Kick from Tyranitar is a threat to it.

decisions.rationale: Trick Room makes Arcanine (110-142) act before Sand Rush Excadrill, and Expert Belt Flare Blitz is a guaranteed OHKO on Excadrill (105-179%), so I can't safely attack with it: Protect blocks the likely Flare Blitz and Arcanine's own Protect is now unreliable. Meanwhile Tyranitar Crunch (Colbur gone) does 58-105% to Farigiraf at 70%, so it has a real chance to remove the Trick Room setter; Head Smash back only does 47-81% to Tyranitar.
decisions.notebook:
SIM CHART QUIRK: Fighting resisted by Psychic here -> Ttar Low Kick vs Farigiraf only neutral; Crunch is the Farigiraf tool. Low Kick vs Kingambit 4x/120BP (98.6-169%). Rock NOT resisted by Rock here (Rock Slide 2x on H-Arcanine; H-Arcanine Head Smash neutral on Ttar).
Verified dmg (L50, sand, Champions): Exca LO High Horsepower vs H-Arcanine 146-268% (OHKO even at -1); Ttar Crunch vs Farigiraf 58-106% full-power / 38.8-71.8% at -1; Ttar -1 Rock Slide vs H-Arcanine 30.7-56.5%. Exca LO HH vs Kingambit 80.7-139%; Exca LO Iron Head OHKOs Mega Gardevoir.
DANGER: EBelt Flare Blitz vs Excadrill 105-179% = GUARANTEED OHKO; H-Arcanine Head Smash vs Ttar 47-81%; Flare Blitz vs Sinistcha ~33-89% (Heatproof halves). Kingambit Sucker Punch vs Ttar 18-25% (Ttar Sucker-proof), vs Exca 59-84%. Mega Gardevoir Aura Sphere vs Ttar 83-119% (never leave Ttar vs live Gardevoir); Mystical Fire vs Exca 49-83%.
KEY RULE: Under enemy Trick Room, Sand Rush Excadrill moves LAST and dies to Flare Blitz - use Protect/switch or keep Excadrill in back until TR expires. Post-TR Exca (236 spe) outspeeds everything but Tailwind Noivern.
Opp team: Farigiraf (Armor Tail blocks priority, TR), H-Arcanine (Intimidate, EBelt), Kingambit, Mega Gardevoir, Milotic, Noivern (Tailwind). Very Protect-heavy: punish the turn after a Protect (consecutive Protect ~1/3 success). Sinistcha Rage Powder (+2 prio, self-target so Armor Tail-safe) shields Ttar from Aura Sphere and Exca from Sucker Punch; Gholdengo walls Aura Sphere/Hyper Voice.

decisions.rationale: Double switch to Kingambit and Gardevoir-Mega under Trick Room. Both leads are preserved against Tyranitar's likely Rock Slide (Kingambit resists, Gardevoir takes neutral). Next turn under TR, Kingambit Iron Head (46‑97%) plus Gardevoir-Mega Pixilate Hyper Voice (2× Fairy into Tyranitar) threats KO on Tyranitar. Farigiraf and Arcanine remain in back to reset TR or clean up later.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Against sand lead, Trick Room set turn 1. Farigiraf’s Colbur Berry consumed. Arcanine’s Protect used. Turn 2 double switch to Kingambit and Gardevoir-Mega (Mega Evolve) under TR. Both leads preserved. Opponent’s back: Gholdengo, Rotom‑Heat, Sinistcha (Trick Room), Floette‑Eternal (Fairy Aura). Our win condition remains TR sweep with Kingambit and Gardevoir‑Mega. Priority: eliminate Tyranitar and Excadrill, then handle Sinistcha’s Trick Room reversal. Gardevoir-Mega Hyper Voice (Pixilate) is Fairy‑type, 2× into Tyranitar. Kingambit Iron Head 2× into Tyranitar. Keep Farigiraf alive to reset TR if needed. Arcanine can clean late‑game with Extreme Speed or Flare Blitz.

decisions.rationale: Excadrill moves last under TR and gets OHKO'd by Aura Sphere (67-108%+LO recoil), so it must leave; Gholdengo is immune to Aura Sphere and Normal Hyper Voice, resists Fairy Hyper Voice, survives Mystical Fire (42-89%), and at 110 Speed moves BEFORE Mega Gardevoir under Trick Room to threaten Make It Rain (52-111% spread). Tyranitar keeps its 4x Low Kick pressure on Kingambit (~74-127% of its current HP even at -1) and only fears Aura Sphere, which is a coin flip rather than a certainty.
decisions.notebook:
SIM QUIRKS: Fighting resisted by Psychic here (Ttar Low Kick vs Farigiraf only neutral; Crunch is the Farigiraf tool). Rock NOT resisted by Rock (Rock Slide 2x on H-Arcanine; Head Smash neutral on Ttar).
PIXILATE (Mega Gardevoir): Hyper Voice becomes FAIRY x1.2 -> ~42-74% spread on Tyranitar (Dark weak), 0.5x on Gholdengo/Excadrill, 1x Sinistcha. Aura Sphere is 0x vs Gholdengo AND Sinistcha (Ghost); Hyper Voice as Fairy still hits them.
Verified (L50, sand): Exca LO HH vs H-Arcanine 146-268% OHKO even at -1; Exca LO HH vs Kingambit 80.7-139% (55-93% at -1); Exca LO Iron Head vs Mega Gard 78.9-158% at -1 (not guaranteed); Ttar Low Kick vs Kingambit 4x/120BP 98.6-169% full, ~66-113% at -1; Ttar Crunch vs Farigiraf 58-106% full / 38.8-71.8% at -1; Ttar -1 Rock Slide vs H-Arcanine 30.7-56.5%. Gholdengo Make It Rain vs Mega Gard 52.6-111% spread (more single-target); Mystical Fire vs Gholdengo 41.8-88.9% (never OHKO).
DANGER: EBelt Flare Blitz OHKOs Excadrill (105-179%); Head Smash vs Ttar 47-81%; Mega Gard Aura Sphere vs Ttar 83-119%, vs Exca 67-108%; Mystical Fire vs Exca 49-83%; Kingambit Sucker Punch vs Ttar only 18-25%, vs Exca 59-84%.
RULES: Under enemy TR keep Excadrill off field (moves last); post-TR Exca 236 spe outspeeds all but Tailwind Noivern. Gholdengo (110) moves BEFORE Mega Gard under TR. Sinistcha Rage Powder (+2, self-target, Armor Tail-safe) shields Ttar from Aura Sphere but eats Dark 2x. Opp very Protect-heavy: punish the turn after a Protect.

decisions.rationale: Trick Room is still up for 3 turns, so Excadrill would move last and get OHKO'd by Flare Blitz/Mystical Fire; keep it in reserve for post-TR sweeping at 236 Speed in sand. Sinistcha is slow (good under TR), Heatproof blunts Mystical Fire, is immune to Aura Sphere and Normal Hyper Voice's Fairy... (still hit, but 1x), and brings Rage Powder redirection plus Matcha Gotcha recovery/spread damage to stabilize while Gholdengo pressures Mega Gardevoir with Make It Rain/Shadow Ball.
decisions.notebook:
SIM QUIRKS: Fighting resisted by Psychic here. Rock NOT resisted by Rock (Rock Slide 2x H-Arcanine; Head Smash neutral on Ttar).
PIXILATE (Mega Gard): Hyper Voice = FAIRY x1.2; 0.5x vs Gholdengo/Excadrill, 1x Sinistcha. Aura Sphere 0x vs Gholdengo AND Sinistcha (Ghost).
Verified L50 sand: Exca LO HighHorsepower vs H-Arcanine 146-268% (OHKO even -1); vs Kingambit 80.7-139% (55-93% at -1). Exca LO Iron Head vs Mega Gard 78.9-158% at -1. Gholdengo MakeItRain vs Mega Gard 52.6-111% spread (more single-target). Mystical Fire vs Gholdengo 41.8-88.9% (never OHKO).
DANGER: EBelt Flare Blitz OHKOs Excadrill (105-179%); Mega Gard Aura Sphere vs Exca 67-108%; Mystical Fire vs Exca 49-83%; Kingambit Sucker Punch vs Exca 59-84%. Kingambit Kowtow/Sucker 2x on Gholdengo and Sinistcha.
RULES: Under enemy TR keep Excadrill off field; post-TR Exca 236 Spe outspeeds everything but Tailwind Noivern. Gholdengo (110) moves BEFORE Mega Gard under TR. Sinistcha Rage Powder (+2, self-target, works through Armor Tail) redirects single-target attacks; Heatproof halves Mystical Fire/Flare Blitz. Sinistcha takes sand chip (Leftovers offsets). Farigiraf's Armor Tail blocks our priority (Protect still fine; it blocks nothing we rely on but no priority attacks available anyway). Opponent very Protect-heavy: punish the turn after a Protect; Arcanine/Farigiraf often double-Protect on turn 1.
Game 2 kills so far: Tyranitar fainted; Kingambit at low HP, Farigiraf chipped, Milotic/Noivern not brought.

decisions.rationale: Double into Tyranitar with Iron Head + Pixilate Hyper Voice. Kingambit moves 1st under TR (70 v 81‑113), then Tyranitar acts, then Mega Gardevoir finishes Tyranitar and chips Excadrill. This eliminates the immediate 4x Low Kick threat and pressures both foes. If Tyranitar Protects, Hyper Voice still hits Excadrill.
decisions.notebook: Win condition: keep Trick Room advantage (Farigiraf can reset). Sweep with Mega Gardevoir Pixilate Hyper Voice + Kingambit. Opp has Sinistcha with TR, Gholdengo (Make It Rain), Rotom‑H, Floette‑E. Arcanine provides late‑game Extreme Speed. Preserve Farigiraf to counter Sinistcha’s TR.

decisions.rationale: Sucker Punch guarantees a KO on Gholdengo (91-130%) and Kingambit moves first under TR, so Gholdengo must be shielded. Rage Powder (+2) resolves before Sucker Punch, which then fails (Sinistcha already moved / status), and redirects Kowtow or Mystical Fire (halved by Heatproof) onto bulky Sinistcha. Freed Gholdengo's Make It Rain is a guaranteed KO on Kingambit from 16% even resisted, while also hitting Mega Gardevoir for 63-108%, a possible KO and at minimum crippling chip.
decisions.notebook:
SIM QUIRKS: Fighting resisted by Psychic here. Rock NOT resisted by Rock (Rock Slide 2x H-Arcanine; Head Smash neutral on Ttar).
PIXILATE (Mega Gard): Hyper Voice = FAIRY x1.2; 0.5x vs Gholdengo/Excadrill, 1x Sinistcha. Aura Sphere 0x vs Gholdengo AND Sinistcha.
VERIFIED L50 sand calcs: Exca LO High Horsepower vs H-Arcanine 146-268% (OHKO even -1); vs Kingambit 80.7-139% (55-93% at -1). Exca LO Iron Head vs Mega Gard 78.9-158% at -1. Gholdengo Make It Rain (WiseGlasses, 199 SpA) spread: vs Mega Gard 62.9-107.7%, vs Kingambit 17.4-32.6%. Sinistcha Shadow Ball vs Mega Gard 43.4-75.5%.
DANGER: Kingambit Sucker Punch vs Gholdengo 91.6-129.7% (OHKO threat any time Gholdengo attacks); Kowtow vs Sinistcha 71.9-124.7%. EBelt Flare Blitz OHKOs Excadrill; Mega Gard Aura Sphere vs Exca 67-108%; Mystical Fire vs Exca 49-83%, vs Gholdengo 41.8-88.9%, vs Sinistcha 61.8-104% before Heatproof halving (~31-52% after).
RULES: Keep Excadrill off field under enemy TR; post-TR Exca 236 Spe outspeeds all but Tailwind Noivern. Gholdengo (110) acts before Mega Gard under TR; Sinistcha (90) acts before Gholdengo under TR. Rage Powder is the key tool: +2, beats Sucker Punch, blanks it (target already moved), redirects single-target attacks off Gholdengo/Excadrill; works while Farigiraf's Armor Tail is off field. Opponent is very Protect-heavy - punish the turn after Protect; Arcanine/Farigiraf often double-Protect turn 1.
Game 2 status notes: Tyranitar fainted; Milotic/Noivern not brought; Farigiraf Colbur consumed.

decisions.rationale: Kowtow Cleave always OHKOs 72% Gholdengo before it moves (78.9% min > 72%). Hyper Voice (Pixilate→Fairy) is a spread move that ignores Rage Powder redirection and chips Sinistcha. If Rage Powder redirects Kowtow Cleave to Sinistcha, combined damage still KOs it. Kingambit survives Sinistcha's Matcha Gotcha (9.2–16% vs 17% HP). TR cancel comes last; we keep offensive momentum.
decisions.notebook: Win condition: keep Trick Room advantage (Farigiraf can reset). Sweep with Mega Gardevoir Pixilate Hyper Voice + Kingambit. Opp has Sinistcha with TR, Gholdengo (Make It Rain), Rotom‑H, Floette‑E. Arcanine provides late‑game Extreme Speed. Preserve Farigiraf to counter Sinistcha’s TR. Supreme Overlord: 1 fallen ally (Tyranitar). Opp Excadrill in back has Sand Rush — threaten under sand if TR falls.

decisions.rationale: Both fainted slots must be filled. Slotting Farigiraf opposite Sinistcha and Arcanine opposite Gholdengo is neutral. Farigiraf under TR (72 Speed) moves before both foes; can KO 15% Sinistcha with Psychic or reset Trick Room. Arcanine's Intimidate debuffs both foes (though they're special attackers), and it threatens Gholdengo with Flare Blitz. Excadrill looms in back.
decisions.notebook: Game 2, score p1 1-0. Both Kingambit and Mega Gardevoir fainted T4. Farigiraf (70%) and Arcanine (100%) remain. Opp has Sinistcha (15%), Gholdengo (72%, -2 SpA), and full Excadrill in back. Trick Room ends after T5 — Farigiraf must reset it. Sinistcha still has Trick Room of its own. Opp's Excadrill has Sand Rush + Life Orb; Arcanine can answer it with Flare Blitz. Farigiraf's Armor Tail blocks foe priority. Wincon: maintain TR control, eliminate Sinistcha first so it can't reverse TR, then handle Gholdengo and Excadrill.

decisions.rationale: EBelt Flare Blitz OHKOs Gholdengo from 73% (112-166%), so Gholdengo must be untouchable: Protect is absolute and also blanks Psychic. Sinistcha at 16% is dying regardless (Psychic or Flare Blitz), so it should trade for maximum value: spread Matcha Gotcha chips Farigiraf and Arcanine ~19-35% each and drains HP, beating a Rage Powder turn that only adds a -2 SpA Thunderbolt (13-24%). Trick Room expires this turn, so Excadrill (236 Spe in sand) comes in next turn to OHKO Arcanine with High Horsepo
decisions.notebook:
SIM QUIRKS: Fighting resisted by Psychic here. Rock NOT resisted by Rock. Sandstorm damages Grass (Sinistcha ~-6%/turn, offset by Leftovers).
ARMOR TAIL: does not block self-target priority (Rage Powder/Protect still work vs Farigiraf).
VERIFIED L50 sand calcs: Exca LO High Horsepower vs H-Arcanine 146-268% (OHKO even -1). Exca LO Iron Head vs Mega Gard 78.9-158% at -1. Gholdengo Make It Rain (WiseGlasses, 199 SpA) spread vs Mega Gard 62.9-107.7%. Gholdengo Thunderbolt at -2 SpA (eff 99): ~12-24% vs Farigiraf and vs H-Arcanine (Electric 1x on Fire/Rock). Sinistcha Matcha Gotcha spread (153 SpA): 18.9-34.9% vs Farigiraf; Grass is 1x on H-Arcanine (0.5x Fire x2 Rock).
DANGER: EBelt Flare Blitz vs Gholdengo 112.9-166.5% (always OHKO, even full HP); OHKOs Excadrill too. H-Arcanine Head Smash only 0.5x on Excadrill. Farigiraf Hyper Voice is 0x vs both Gholdengo and Sinistcha; Psychic 0.5x vs Gholdengo, 1x vs Sinistcha. Extreme Speed 0x vs both Ghosts.
RULES: Make It Rain drops own SpA by 2 in this sim - avoid spamming; boosts reset on switch. Keep Excadrill off field while enemy TR up; without TR Exca 236 Spe outspeeds all but Tailwind Noivern and OHKOs H-Arcanine. Opponent is very Protect-heavy (double Protect turn 1 common) - punish the turn after Protect. Milotic/Noivern unseen in game 2 (not brought).

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Under TR Farigiraf moves first and Psychic OHKOs 15% Sinistcha barring Protect, removing its TR threat. Arcanine's Flare Blitz targets Gholdengo (2x effective) to pressure it. If Sinistcha Rage Powders, both attacks redirect and it still faints. If Sinistcha Protects, Psychic is blocked but Flare Blitz still damages Gholdengo, and TR expires end of turn.
decisions.notebook: Game 2, score p1 1-0. Both Kingambit and Mega Gardevoir fainted T4. Opp has Sinistcha (TR, Rage Powder, Heatproof), Gholdengo (Wise Glasses, GoodAsGold), and Excadrill (Life Orb, Sand Rush) in back. Sandstorm active. Farigiraf is my TR setter with Armor Tail; Arcanine is my main damage with Expert Belt Flare Blitz. Wincon: eliminate Sinistcha first to control TR, then handle Excadrill with Arcanine under TR. Excadrill OHKOs Farigiraf with High Horsepower, so TR must be up before Excadrill enters.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Excadrill (236 Spe in sand) moves first and High Horsepower is a guaranteed OHKO on H-Arcanine (215-397%), removing the only real threat (EBelt Flare Blitz OHKOs both my mons). Gholdengo at -2 SpA does negligible damage and Shadow Ball is 0x on Farigiraf, so it Protects as insurance if Arcanine Protects or HH misses (5%); even at reduced success it's better value than chip. Then Excadrill cleans Farigiraf.
decisions.notebook:
SIM QUIRKS: Fighting resisted by Psychic here. Rock NOT resisted by Rock. Sandstorm damages Grass.
ARMOR TAIL: does not block self-target priority (Protect/Rage Powder still work).
VERIFIED L50 sand calcs: Exca LO High Horsepower (205 Atk) vs H-Arcanine 215-397% (guaranteed OHKO, even at -1). Exca LO Iron Head vs Mega Gardevoir 78.9-158% at -1. Gholdengo Make It Rain (WiseGlasses, 199 SpA) spread vs Mega Gard 62.9-107.7%. Gholdengo at -2 SpA is nearly useless (~12-24% on neutral targets).
DANGER: H-Arcanine EBelt Flare Blitz OHKOs Gholdengo and Excadrill; its Head Smash is only 0.25x on Excadrill, ExtremeSpeed 0x on Ghosts. Farigiraf offense is feeble vs my core: Hyper Voice 0x vs Gholdengo, Psychic 0.5x vs both Steel/Ghost and Ground/Steel.
RULES/PLANS: Make It Rain self-drops SpA 2 in this sim; boosts reset on switch, so consider pivoting Gholdengo out after using it. Keep Excadrill off field while enemy Trick Room is up; outside TR sand-rushed Excadrill (236) outspeeds everything but Tailwind Noivern. Opponent is very Protect-heavy (frequent double Protect turn 1) - lead with pressure but expect Protect, punish the following turn. Unseen this game: Milotic, Noivern (Tailwind + Super Fang, WideLens).
GAME 3 PREP: Excadrill in sand is the win condition; Tyranitar dies fast to Iron Head/Hyper Voice - protect it or lead differently.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Arcanine-Hisui)
decisions.rationale: Excadrill outspeeds in sand and OHKOs Arcanine with High Horsepower. Protecting Arcanine blocks that while Farigiraf sets Trick Room. Farigiraf at 64% survives most single hits from either foe; only double-targeting KOs it, but Excadrill is overwhelmingly likely to target the 4x-weak Arcanine. Once TR is up, Farigiraf moves first next turn and Arcanine Flare Blitz OHKOs Excadrill under reversed order.
decisions.notebook: Game 2, score 1-0. Win condition: set Trick Room, then Arcanine Flare Blitz sweeps Excadrill and Gholdengo under TR. Farigiraf must survive to set TR. Arcanine Protect is key to survive Excadrill's Sand Rush-boosted attacks. Once TR is up, speed order: Farigiraf (72) > Gholdengo (104-136) > Arcanine (132) > Excadrill (216-280). Farigiraf can support with Psychic while Arcanine KOs threats. Sandstorm has 3 turns remaining.

decisions.rationale: Under Trick Room Arcanine acts before Excadrill and Expert Belt Flare Blitz is a guaranteed OHKO on Excadrill (105-179%), so attacking now risks losing my win condition before it can act. Both Protects are fresh (Gholdengo's stall counter reset when its Protect failed last turn), so double Protect is near-free: it blanks Flare Blitz, burns a Trick Room turn, and keeps Gholdengo alive as a second possible target so the opponent can't safely commit to Excadrill later. decisions.notebook:
SIM QUIRKS: Fighting resisted by Psychic. Rock NOT resisted by Rock. Sandstorm damages Grass. Armor Tail does not stop self-target priority (Protect/Rage Powder work). Protect stall counter RESETS when a Protect fails, so a failed Protect restores full success next turn.
VERIFIED L50 calcs (sand): Exca LO High Horsepower (205 Atk) vs H-Arcanine 215-397% (OHKO even at -1); Exca LO Rock Slide vs H-Arcanine 43-79%; Exca LO Iron Head vs Farigiraf 40-74%; Exca LO Iron Head vs Mega Gard 79-158% at -1; Gholdengo Make It Rain (WiseGlasses 199 SpA) spread vs Mega Gard 63-108%; Gholdengo Thunderbolt at -2 SpA vs H-Arcanine only 13-24%.
DANGER: H-Arcanine EBelt Flare Blitz OHKOs Excadrill (105-179%) and Gholdengo; its Head Smash 0.25x on Excadrill, ExtremeSpeed 0x on Ghost. Farigiraf can barely damage Steel/Ghost + Ground/Steel (Hyper Voice 0x on Gholdengo, Psychic 0.5x on both).
ENDGAME THEORY: vs TR team, Excadrill-attack-vs-Protect is matching pennies; use fresh Protect early, attack when Protect is degraded. Trick Room cannot be re-set while active, so the turn right after TR expires is my free window: Excadrill 118 beats likely min-speed (110) Adamant H-Arcanine even without sand.
GAME 3 PREP: Excadrill in sand is the win condition; Tyranitar folds to Iron Head/Hyper Voice. Avoid using Make It Rain early (-2 SpA sticks with no switch outs). Opponent is Protect-heavy and runs Farigiraf TR support; unseen: Milotic, Noivern (Tailwind, Super Fang, Wide Lens).

decisions.rationale: Under TR, Farigiraf moves first, then Gholdengo, then Arcanine, then Excadrill. Both targeting Excadrill: if it doesn't Protect, Flare Blitz OHKOs it before it can move, leaving only -2 SpA Gholdengo. If Excadrill Protects, both attacks are blocked but Gholdengo's chip (38-45% to Farigiraf or 40-57% to Arcanine at -2) KOs neither. Arcanine's Protect is at 50% so unreliable. This line eliminates the only OHKO threat while preserving both Pokémon for a 2v1 endgame.
decisions.notebook: Game 2, score 1-0. Won Game 1. TR + Arcanine-Hisui sweep strategy. Farigiraf is TR setter with Armor Tail blocking priority.
